description:
Estimate cost and latency for parsing a document.
Accepts a file path or sample_id. No auth required.
Returned through mcpOutput, like every other MCP tool: a JSON value (not a
double-encoded string) without request_id/meta, which OpenAI review forbids
in tool results. The REST estimate route keeps them.
name: mcpEstimate
title: Estimate cost and latency
